title: DecideResponse
description: Exact shapes of every successful POST /decide response body from _handle_decide_post in src/egress_broker_host.py: one anyOf branch per decision path.

anyOf.title: AllowResponse
anyOf.description: decision=allow: request ids whose allow was applied, plus the allows that produced no rule.

decided.$comment: Request ids whose allow was applied.

reason.$comment: Allow-path error reasons returned by _close_request in src/egress_broker_host.py (IP_REQUIRES_CIDR_REASON, APPLY_FAILED_REASON); APPLY_IN_PROGRESS_REASON is skipped, never listed.

anyOf.title: DenyOnceResponse
anyOf.description: decision=deny scope=once: the open request ids the one-shot deny closed.

anyOf.title: PersistentDenyResponse
anyOf.description: decision=deny scope=bottle|global: the swept request ids plus the denylist entry that was written.

decided.$comment: Request ids swept closed by persist_deny().

scope.$comment: NOT a closed enum: persist_deny in src/egress_broker_host.py accepts scope bottle|global, and the response records write_scope — the bottle's own name for scope=bottle (validated by validate_bottle_scope in src/egress_denylist.py) or the literal "global" for scope=global.
